verdict.rationale: cubic has a coding-agent capability: a one-click "Fix with cubic" on a review comment generates the fix server-side and pushes commits to the PR branch. That is a narrow form of delegating coding work to run remotely. It is limited to targeted fixes for review findings, not general long-running tasks, and Ultrareview's ~30-minute runs are reviews rather than coding. Missing for 10: delegation of arbitrary longer-running coding tasks, evidence of an isolated or sandboxed cloud execution environment, background task management and monitoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
